    Reverse linear extensions with a consecutive antichain block #

    This file constructs the order extension invoked in the equality argument of the frozen manuscript: any specified three-element antichain can be made a consecutive block in a reverse linear extension.

    source

    • not_bc : ¬b ≤ c
